title: Review of c43's conserved-enzyme consumer (seed 7 re-run, consumer-free twin and prey-removal fork): X and a dynamical E replicate; consumer division is mostly joint fission of prey-consumer composites, only 2 strict consumer splits in 12000 t
summary: Re-ran world.py at defaults on a new seed (rerun/seed7, 128^2, 120 frames, --lineage-k 5), the consumer-free twin (twin/seed7, pred_on 0) and the prey-removal fork at t=3000 (efork/seed7, tcut 3000). The run matches the claim: consumers as bands on prey edges and some free dots, 35 consumers and 39 prey at t=12000, consumer persistent splits 30 (generation 4), prey 83 (generation 8), merge/split 0.05. The twin is a frozen emulsion of 75 prey with 1 persistent split. The fork removes all consumers between t=3000 and t=3100 (31 -> 0). With the claim's own strict test (splits3.py, both daughters >= 8 px and alive 500 t later) I find only 2 consumer splits in seed 7 (claim: 3 and 4), both a V-shaped band on a C-shaped prey droplet that splits with it into two band-prey pairs (cons_splits_s7.png).

observations.S: rerun/seed7/sheet.png t=0: smoothed noise over the whole domain
observations.I: rerun/seed7/sheet.png t=1000-12000: about 30-35 consumer condensates of q, mostly bands on prey edges that move with their prey, a few free round dots
observations.X: twin/seed7 (pred_on 0, same seed, grid, duration, window): 75 static prey, 1 persistent split, vs 39 prey and 83 persistent prey splits with consumers (rerun/seed7/FACTS.md)
observations.E: efork/seed7/metrics.json species n_comp: consumers 31 at t=3000 -> 0 at t=3100 after prey removal; q is never made from prey, so the dependence is dynamical
observations.D: labkit consumer persistent splits 30, generation 4 (rerun/seed7/FACTS.md), but the strict test (splits3.py, daughters >= 8 px alive 500 t later) finds 2 events (cons_splits_s7.png t=3600, t=4700), both joint fission of a band with the prey droplet it sits on

verdicts.limitation: Weak because the consumer is mostly a layer on one side of its prey droplet, and its division is fission of that prey-consumer composite driven by the prey pinching: labkit's 30 persistent consumer splits shrink to 2 strict, persistent events in 12000 t (the claim's 3 and 4), so D for the consumer kind is thin; the prey's E is by construction (made from fuel), as the claim says. One fresh seed, defaults only, no dt/2.
